newsitem.title: USA: Neogen Corp not connected to abortion pill.
newsitem.headline: Neogen Corp not connected to abortion pill.

text.p: Neogen Corp said Monday it was not in any way related to San Diego, Calif.-based Neogen Investors LP, a firm involved in a legal dispute over the U.S. license for the French abortion pill RU-486.

"We only recently learned that a California firm was using our trade name and have immediately advised them to cease and desist," Neogen Corp President James Herbert said in a statement. "Neogen has no connection with the California firm or any of its activities. If a correction is not made immediately by the California firm, we will take appropriate legal action."
On Friday, a Reuters story incorrectly included Neogen Corp.'s stock symbol following a reference to Neogen Investors LP and RU-486.

Lansing, Mich.-based Neogen Corp is a 15-year-old company specializing in products to improve the safety and quality of the food, agriculture and environmental industries. Among its products are diagnostic test kits for bacterial and fungus contamination of food and crops.
Neogen Corp said it never had any conversations with officials of the San Diego firm and is not involved in drugs for human medicine in any respect.
